activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock index is in an established weekly uptrend with Weekly MACD > 0. On the daily chart, Slow Stochastics drops below 20 while Investor Sentiment polls report 85% bullish consensus. How should a disciplined chartist resolve these signals?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock index is in an established weekly uptrend with Weekly MACD > 0. On the daily chart, Slow Stochastics drops below 20 while Investor Sentiment polls report 85% bullish consensus. How should a disciplined chartist resolve these signals?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Stand aside and avoid buying the daily oversold dip! 85% bullish sentiment signals extreme herd consensus and exhaustion of buying power. Murphy teaches that when sentiment exceeds 80%, prepare for a major top once price confirms by breaking support.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
